topic: Gareth Edwards exits Jurassic World Rebirth sequel
headline: GARETH EDWARDS EXITS JURASSIC WORLD REBIRTH SEQUEL AFTER MIXED REVIEWS FOR THE LATEST INSTALLMENT
summary: Gareth Edwards, the director of Jurassic World Rebirth, has exited the sequel to the film. The latest installment in the Jurassic World series received mixed reviews, with some critics praising its return to form and others finding it stale and lacking in thrills. Despite this, the film opened in first place at the box office. Edwards' departure from the sequel has been announced, but no further details have been provided.
